From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Aditi Kumar <aditi.kumar@evolvecare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Sep 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: 30-min product intro and SME rotation

Hi Aditi —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and a proposed next step so we can keep momentum:

- Goal for the next meeting: 30-minute product intro (high-level flow + brief infra/discovery Q&A).
- Audience: product manager, one engineering/infra contact (we recommend ops/infra for the technical deep dive).
- Success criteria: see two bullets in the attached agenda — if you have anything to add, let us know.

Could you confirm which of these slots works for your team next week (all times PDT):
1) Wed 9/24 10:00–10:30am
2) Thu 9/25 2:30–3:00pm
3) Fri 9/26 11:00–11:30am

If none of those work, tell us 2 windows that do and which stakeholders will join (ops contact + product sponsor). I’ve attached a short 30-min agenda and a one-page SOW outline so your procurement folks can see the scope.

Marissa, copying you in — if Aditi picks a slot, can you own the calendar invite and include the Redwood SE (Ben) for the technical portion? Ben, FYI you may get a calendar invite — likely short prep beforehand.

Thanks —
Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

Attachments: RW-demo-agenda-MVP.pdf (1 page), SOW-outline-v1.docx (stub)
